name: SBG AI Layer
author: tdainat01

sections.description:
SBG AI Layer gives your WordPress site a lightweight AI discovery layer using machine-readable endpoints and structured outputs.

The free version focuses on foundational discovery and indexing support so AI systems, search tools, and language models can better interpret your site.

Features include:

  • AI discovery endpoint
  • LLM index output
  • llms.txt support
  • AI sitemap output
  • Entities output
  • Knowledge graph output
  • Lightweight admin interface

The plugin works on its own and does not require an external service in the free version.

SBG AI Layer Pro is available separately for sites that need advanced AI enrichment, remote analysis, automation, and expanded optimization features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sbg-ai-layer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Visit Settings > SBG AI Layer.
  4. Review the generated endpoint URLs and save permalinks once if needed.
sections.faq:
Does the free version require an external service?

No. The free version works independently and provides the core discovery endpoints and structured outputs locally.

What does Pro add?

The Pro version adds advanced AI enrichment, remote analysis, expanded artifact generation, and automation features.

Will this slow down my site?

The free version is designed to stay lightweight and avoids heavy remote processing.
